profile.headline: Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Evening class instructor teaching data technology and analytics, including the following key topics: Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Data Visualization, Python, R, Machine Learning, Google BigQuery, and Statistics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET)
positions.description: Served in QE (Quality Engineer) and Scrum Master roles for the Hint Services Team. Responsible for the development, quality engineering, and operational support of hint services, providing our customers with “hints” (recommendations) to personas, photos, stories, and other records that source and support genealogical research and family tree building.  We develop services and endpoints in Java using IntelliJ, GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, and AWS.  Unit and integration tests are written using JUnit and Mockito.
